acs.text: WHILE a follower is following someone in a room, WHEN they click or press keys anywhere (Social's room window, the call window, Join call, the reader) without their reader moving away from the followed person's place, THE SYSTEM SHALL keep them following (status `live`, the room window says "Following <name>")
scenarios: AC-001 clicks that do not move the reader keep a follower following

acs.text: WHILE a follower is following someone, WHEN their reader settles (no input or change for 400 ms) on a segment of the same section as the followed person's segment and fewer than 5 segments away, THE SYSTEM SHALL keep them following, and the followed person's next move SHALL bring them to the new place
scenarios: AC-002 a small move keeps following

acs.text: WHILE a follower is following someone, WHEN their reader settles in another book or section, or 5 or more segments away in the same section, THE SYSTEM SHALL set them on their own (status `paused`, "You are on your own" with Follow again)
scenarios: AC-003 a clear move breaks away

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in member asks the social API for a relay ticket for a room (`POST /api/v1/rooms/{roomId}/ticket`) THE SYSTEM SHALL answer with a 10-minute ticket naming the caller and their role, `owner` for the room's owner and `member` for anyone else; a caller who is not a member SHALL get 404
scenarios: AC-004 the server issues a room ticket with the caller's role

acs.text: WHEN a socket joins an ordinary room on the relay THE SYSTEM SHALL make the participant a host who may lead only when it offers a valid owner ticket for that room and that user; with a member ticket, no ticket, an expired or tampered ticket, or a ticket for another room or user, the participant SHALL join as a member who cannot lead, and a member's request to move the spotlight SHALL be refused
scenarios: AC-005 only the owner's ticket makes a leader

acs.text: WHILE the viewer is in a room THE SYSTEM SHALL offer no Lead button and no leadership-mode control; the room's owner holds the spotlight from the moment they join

WHEN the viewer clicks another person, in the room window's list of who is here or on that person's call tile, THE SYSTEM SHALL follow that person; WHEN the viewer clicks the person they follow again, or the leader, THE SYSTEM SHALL return them to following the leader; WHEN the leader follows someone, the room window SHALL offer "Lead again", which returns the leader to leading
scenarios: AC-007 follow a person by clicking them

acs.text: WHEN the leader follows person B, THE SYSTEM SHALL bring everyone who follows the leader to B's place, and keep doing so while the leader follows B; two people who follow each other SHALL NOT send each other their state more than once per move
scenarios: AC-008 the leader takes followers along
